author: Mark Julius Banasihan
statement: On 10 October 2026, the author approved the revised preprint and the additional ZG710 reassessment supplement following final review. This public statement records that approval without reproducing private review communications.
scientific_scope: The additional ZG710 dispositions are comprehension I, feasibility {P,I}, and exercise {P,I}, with the other Stage 2 inputs retained. The released condition definitions, case boundaries, direct-contemporaneous S requirement, and aggregation rule remain unchanged. Broader Stage 3 amendments are not adopted.
interpretive_limit: Approval and computational reproduction do not constitute independent empirical validation of the historical evidence, coding judgments, or method.
release_status: Prepared for final public-packaging review. Upload, publication, and resubmission remain separate actions.
